name: Jackery Explorer 300
summary: The original Explorer 300 is a small lithium-ion station with a 300 W AC ceiling; its revision needs checking before purchase.
description: This record covers the original Explorer 300, not the 300 Plus, 300 v2 or 300D. It is a candidate for small-device planning rather than heating or cooking loads. Manufacturer documentation and the current Canadian page describe different capacity figures, so the precise battery label must be matched to the supplied ASIN before this becomes a recommendation.

specs.label: Documented legacy capacity
specs.value: 293.8 Wh in the original user manual; exact listing revision pending

specs.label: Battery chemistry
specs.value: Original manufacturer reference: NCM lithium-ion; chemistry of the selected Canadian unit is not established

specs.label: Rated AC output
specs.value: Original US manual reference: 300 W total at 110 V / 60 Hz, 500 W surge; not a verified Canadian unit rating

specs.label: AC outlets
specs.value: Two, sharing the total AC rating

specs.label: USB-C input/output
specs.value: Original manufacturer reference: 60 W maximum; match the actual delivered revision

specs.label: Charging options
specs.value: Wall adapter, car input, USB-C and a compatible solar panel

pros: USB-C can charge the station and supported devices.
Two AC outlets allow a small shared load.
cons: Capacity and regional revision are not yet matched to the Amazon listing.
The original NCM reference is distinct from newer models; the recorded listing cannot be assigned a chemistry from inconsistent retailer fields.
Jackery Canada explicitly excludes Explorer 300 from SolarSaga 100 Air recharging compatibility.
